profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou and listed on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. On its own site the company describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle (AAV) technology platform company and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. It says it provides AAV products and commercial solutions to customers across several areas: urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions. The site also lists emergency rescue and infrastructure solutions among its offerings and presents the company as a forerunner in AAV technology and commercial solutions in the global urban air mobility industry.

The site's product and news navigation points to passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media and infrastructure solutions, along with investor relations material. Beyond that, the available record contains no tracked product entries, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers associated with the company. Its registration details list it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001759783.
